The branch history register is then updated (at the next positive clock edge) for the predicted branch.
If training and prediction of the same PHT entry happen at the same time, the prediction sees the PHT state before training because training only modifies the PHT at the next positive clock edge.
When this happens, training takes precedence, because the branch being predicted will be discarded anyway.
